newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belfox lowers USD/BFR option strike price interval.
newsitem.headline: Belfox lowers USD/BFR option strike price interval.

text.p: Belfox, the Belgian futures and options exchange, said on Friday the strike price intervals of its dollar/Belgian franc exchange rate options would be reduced from one franc to 0.5 francs, effective Monday.
It recalled in a statement that in June the expiry months scheduling was modified to replace the quarterly expiries with proposed one, two, three and six month expiries.
The option was launched in September 1994. In the first 11 months of 1996 volume of the contracts traded was 115,684 and open interest was 13,347 contracts, Belfox said.
